title: AMEND: Constraint-Guided Multi-Agent Text Detoxification with Isolated Critics
abstract: arXiv:2610.23183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text detoxification requires balancing toxicity removal, semantic preservation, and fluency. Existing methods typically optimize an unconstrained scalar objective---enabling safety scores to mask semantic loss---or rely on open-ended iterative debate prone to semantic drift and high computational cost. We propose AMEND, an inference-time framework that decouples detoxification into role-conditioned proposal generation, isolated multidimensional criticism, and constraint-first selection. AMEND evaluates diverse candidates with role-blind critics and enforces strict semantic and fluency feasibility before ranking by utility. To maximize efficiency, AMEND Lite restricts subsequent search to at most one targeted repair round only when residual toxic spans remain. translated_abstract: 文本解毒需要在去除毒性、保留语义和保持流畅性三者之间取得平衡。现有方法通常优化一个无约束的标量目标——这使得安全评分可能掩盖语义损失——或依赖开放式迭代辩论，容易导致语义漂移和高昂的计算成本。我们提出AMEND，一个推理时框架，它将解毒过程解耦为基于角色条件的候选生成、隔离的多维度批评以及约束优先的选择。AMEND使用角色盲的评论员来评估多样化的候选方案，并在按效用排序之前严格执行语义和流畅性可行性约束。为了最大化效率，AMEND Lite仅当残留毒性片段存在时，才将后续搜索限制为最多一轮针对性修复。在ParaDetox数据集上，对多样化角色进行一轮选择相比最佳单一角色将联合评估指标提升了+0.0508。在一个冻结的确认测试集上，AMEND Lite实
tldr: AMEND是一个推理时框架，通过角色条件化候选生成、隔离的多维评论员批评和约束优先选择机制来解耦文本解毒过程，其轻量版AMEND Lite仅在残留毒性时进行最多一轮修复，兼顾了去毒效果与计算效率。
en_tdlr: AMEND is an inference-time framework that decouples text detoxification into role-conditioned proposal generation, isolated multidimensional criticism, and constraint-first selection, with its lightweight variant AMEND Lite performing at most one targeted repair round only when residual toxic spans remain, balancing detoxification quality with computational efficiency.
